description:
As an Advanced Software Engineer here at Honeywell Engineering Test Services you will design, develop, test and deploy software solutions that support engine test automation and data acquisition. Responsibilities include writing software to support the acquisition of Engine Data for both Development and Production testing, maintaining a variety of software tools as hardware and software upgrades occur, and supporting engine testing to be responsive when systems fail in the field.

 In this role, you will impact the efficiency and accuracy of engine testing processes by creating robust software solutions and systems that automate data collection and support real-time analysis. Your work will directly contribute to the acquisition and analysis of critical engine test data, helping to drive innovation and quality in aerospace engine development and testing.

 Design, develop, test, and deploy software that support engine test automation and data acquisition.
 Maintain and support existing software solutions and tools
 Implement clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following internal standards and best practices
 Able to diagnose software/hardware issues quickly 
 Assist in the integration of instrumentation and hardware interfaces into software systems
 Participate in code reviews, testing, and validation of software releases to ensure system reliability
 Work closely and collaborate with test engineers and internal customers to gather requirements and deliver functional software solutions
 Work with customers to troubleshoot and resolve issues in lab environments, often involving interaction between software and hardware systems
 
 YOU MUST HAVE 
 Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as science, technology, engineering, mathematics
 Software Coding Experience in 2 or more languages, like Python, Java, C++
 Strong knowledge of software design, development, and testing methodologies
 4+ years of experience in software development lifecycle including validation and verification
 Familiarity with basic Linux/Unix command line tools
 WE VALUE 
 Advanced degree in computer science or related engineering fields.
 Experience in software development supporting data acquisition systems, test automation systems or related is of value. 
 Experience testing software applications in open and close-loop environments
 4+ years with data structures and SQL databases
 4+ years experience with ethernet based communication protocols like Modbus TCP/IP, OPCUA
 4+ years experience with object-oriented programming
 A work ethic that places safety and data quality as the highest priorities
 Knowledge of software configuration management and Software Quality Assurance (SQA) tools such as Git, bitbucket, JIRA, and/or Subversion
 Familiarity with ARINC 429 and MIL-STD-1553 is of value.
 Good communication skills, both oral and written, with our customers
 Proven ability to work with minimal direction in a cross-functional team environment
 Willingness to respond quickly with quality solutions in support of our customers
 A growth mindset and willingness to learn new tools, frameworks, or technologies as needed
 BENEFITS OF WORKING AT HONEYWELL AEROSPACE 
 Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:
• Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
• Short-term and long-term disability coverage
• 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
• Employee assistance program and educational assistance
• Parental leave and 12 paid holidays
• Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time
Explore your benefits: https://honeywellaerospacebenefits.com/ 
 U.S. PERSON REQUIREMENTS 
 Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. Person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status or have the ability to obtain an export authorization.​

 ABOUT HONEYWELL AEROSPACE 
 Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution. 
 Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.
 Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.
 Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.
 ABOUT HONEYWELL ELECTRONIC SOLUTIONS 
 Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space — from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board. 
 As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com 
 Honeywell Aerospace Electronic Solutions develops the avionics, navigation systems, sensors and electromagnetic defense technology that help aircraft perform safely and with precision. Our systems are on board 90% of the world's aircraft — serving commercial aviation, defense and space operators from integrated flight deck platforms with 30-plus years in service to radiation-hardened systems trusted for human spaceflight.
 The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. Job Posting Date: Nov 1st, 2026   #LI-Hybrid
